ValidationRule.description: Require Country/Industry on Travel Opps when adding XB products
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Travel', Family__c = 'Cross Border', OR ( ISBLANK(Opportunity.Account.ShippingCountry), ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity.Account.Account_Industry__c)), AND( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.Account.Account_Industry__c,'Accommodations'), ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity.Account.Account_Sub_Industry__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields on the Account are required to add Products: Shipping Country, Account Industry, Account Sub Industry, if Accomodations.
